title: andruris khasiana
intro: Andruris khasiana, commonly known as Sikkim Coleus, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of Andruris khasiana include its use in treating fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, further research is required to confirm the efficacy and safety of its use for medicinal purposes.
